verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS changelog and engagement platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis. The evidence only mentions an API, webhooks, an embed code and a WordPress plugin, and never mentions official language SDKs. Probes for llms.txt, markdown API docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so nothing in the pack shows a developer SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
